latin: Quaelibet res, quaecunque sit illa, in puritate sui esse constituta est intelligens, intellectus, et intellectum.
translation: Any thing whatever, whatever it may be, when established in the purity of its own being, is at once the one understanding, the understanding itself, and the thing understood.
